text: To reduce the burden on the expert, the authors train a human predictor H' to imitate H's role (identifying subquestions and combining subanswers) and train X from Amplify_H'(X) instead of consulting H directly. Because X keeps changing, H' faces a non-stationary distribution and must be updated continuously during training.
title: Learned human predictor H' replaces direct calls to the human decomposer
